summary: Full functional pass for iteration-34 batch: Job Cards CRUD, Compliance Docs CRUD (with https:// auto-prefix on links), Operator Financial & Contact + Bank persistence, Documents doc_type regression (ComplianceDoc still stores doc_type), Calendar VOR event span (event per day), and viewer-role write-guard on the new endpoints. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed. Frontend E2E via Playwright: 8/8 scenarios passed (login, job card create/edit/delete with JC-0001 auto number, compliance doc create/edit/delete with auto https://, operator save+reload persistence).
action_items: Minor (non-blocking): JobCard vehicle picker (data-testid=jc-vehicle) logs 'Encountered two children with the same key: AB12 CDE' — the vehicle list passed to the Select has a duplicate registration. Deduplicate the vehicles list (or ensure unique keys) in JobCards.js when building SelectItem entries.
Cosmetic: on /operator load two 401s appear in console (pre-existing pattern noted in iter-33). Not caused by this batch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~5047 lines — strongly recommend splitting by feature (job-cards, compliance-docs, operator, calendar, documents) into routers/modules. Long single-file backends are hard to maintain.

In /api/compliance-docs POST, the ComplianceDocInput -> CompanyDoc mapping is correct after the rename; consider adding a Pydantic validator to normalise link_url (add https:// server-side too) so any non-UI caller also gets the fix — right now only the JS layer normalises the URL.
Calendar VOR span caps at 366 days (min((vend-vstart).days, 366)+1). Consider explicit validation to reject expected_return older than off_date rather than silently swapping vstart/vend.

JobCard job_number is generated from count_documents({user_id}), which is not concurrency-safe (two simultaneous POSTs could produce the same JC-XXXX). Use an atomic sequence collection (findOneAndUpdate $inc) for reliable numbering.
seed_data_creation: All test data (job cards, compliance docs, TEST vehicles, TEST viewer invitation, VOR state) is cleaned up by the pytest fixtures. Frontend UI test also created + deleted its own job card & compliance doc. Operator financial fields were set to real-looking demo values (VAT GB999888777, IBAN GB29NWBK60161331926819, sort 40-40-40, acct 87654321) — main agent may want to reset these if they should remain blank.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-34 batch (Job Cards, Compliance Docs, Operator financials, VOR calendar span) is fully working end-to-end. Viewer role write-guard covers /api/job-cards and /api/compliance-docs (POST/PUT/DELETE -> 403). The Documents regression is safe — /api/documents still uses the old ComplianceDoc model and doc_type persists. Only outstanding non-blocking item is a duplicate-key React warning in the JobCards vehicle Select (dedupe the vehicles list). Operator page still has 2 harmless 401s in console (pre-existing).
